official_name: Ministry of Interior — Citizenship and Business Department

access_requirements: RSD includes registration, interview, assessment, review and a decision by the Commissioner for Refugee Affairs; appeals follow statutory process.

mandate_summary: Implements decisions of the National Citizenship and Immigration Board; handles citizenship by registration and naturalisation and administers passports and immigration services.

access_requirements: Citizenship applications and passport services are processed through official NCIC channels under the relevant Act and Board procedures.

official_name: Office of the Prime Minister — Department of Refugees

official_name: Directorate General of Immigration and Emigration

review_notes: Existing passport issuer record should cross-reference this institution.

mandate_summary: Issues Botswana passports and facilitates citizenship, visas, residence permits and immigration services.

access_requirements: Passport, residence and citizenship applications use official portals and forms; legal route-specific procedures should be assessed independently.

official_name: Refugee Services Department — Ministry of Home Affairs

mandate_summary: NIDA registers and identifies people resident in Tanzania, maintains the National Population Register and issues national identity cards to citizens, lawful resident foreigners and refugees who meet the requirements.

access_requirements: Self-service and stakeholder-only services are separated; verification and reconciliation are limited to NIDA stakeholders. Partner registration and access authorization are required.

review_notes: Cross-reference issuer record TZ-ID-21. Official NIDA mandate includes citizens, resident foreigners and refugees. Stakeholder verification portal is not a public API.

official_name: Présidence de la République / Président de la République
english_name: Presidency of the Republic / President of the Republic
mandate_summary: Under Decree No. 2025-1559, refugee or stateless status is granted by decree upon application. The CNGRA processes the case and prepares draft admission decrees after a favourable opinion; the presidential decree is the formal act granting the status.
api_or_digital_service_name: Presidential admission decree
access_requirements: No technical API or digital government integration is asserted. The decree is a legal decision instrument, not an API.
case_route_or_procedure_summary: Applications are addressed to the President and submitted through the CNGRA Permanent Secretariat or competent regional committee; the CNGRA process precedes the decree.
review_notes: Final legal status is conferred by decree. Node Core OS must not issue or simulate a refugee/statelessness status.

official_name: Commission nationale de Gestion des Réfugiés et des Apatrides (CNGRA)
english_name: National Commission for the Management of Refugees and Stateless Persons (CNGRA)
mandate_summary: Law No. 2022-01 establishes the CNGRA as the national structure for refugee and statelessness matters. Decree No. 2025-1559 assigns intake, file registration, interviews, eligibility review, appeals processing and preparation of draft admission decrees to the CNGRA and its committees. A positive opinion is followed by an admission decree; the CNGRA is not the final decree-granting authority.
api_or_digital_service_name: CNGRA Permanent Secretariat; Eligibility Committee; Committee of Recourse; regional committees
access_requirements: The decree permits electronic submission of an application; this does not establish a public API, active web form, or Node Core OS access.
case_route_or_procedure_summary: Applications may be submitted to the Permanent Secretariat or a territorially competent regional committee. The Secretariat registers the file and database record, organizes the interview, and submits the file to the Eligibility Committee. A negative eligibility opinion may be appealed to the CNGRA Committee of Recourse within 45 days; a negative appeal decision may be challenged before the Supreme Court.
review_notes: The legal text expressly covers both refugees and stateless persons. No operational API or third-party case-data access is claimed; personal case records are outside public mapping.

official_name: Ministère de l'Intérieur et de la Sécurité publique
english_name: Ministry of the Interior and Public Security
mandate_summary: Decree No. 2025-1560 identifies the Ministry of the Interior and Public Security as the issuer of biometric identity cards and travel documents for recognized refugees and stateless persons. Decree No. 2025-1559 provides that the Minister issues the corresponding documents after admission by decree. The Ministry also publishes national identity and ordinary passport service procedures.
api_or_digital_service_name: National identity card, ordinary passport and refugee/stateless biometric identity and travel documents
access_requirements: No external API specification or access permission is asserted; the mapping records official administrative services only.
case_route_or_procedure_summary: For refugee/stateless documents, issuance follows formal admission by decree and is coordinated with the CNGRA. National identity cards and ordinary passports are separate citizen document pathways.
review_notes: A refugee/stateless identity card or travel document is not Senegalese nationality or an ordinary national passport.

mandate_summary: The Ministry describes the DAF as responsible for non-police population files, centralized file processing and related information systems. Its published remit includes processing for biometric national identity cards and lists foreigner and refugee identity documents among other document files. The current production chain for the biometric stateless-person card introduced by Decree No. 2025-1560 requires confirmation.
api_or_digital_service_name: Non-police population files; biometric ID card production and related files
access_requirements: No external API documentation was researched or confirmed; the Ministry's DAF page also publishes a telephone identity-card verification contact, not an API.
case_route_or_procedure_summary: Operational role for citizen identity-card enrolment and population-file processing is documented. For refugee/stateless biometric cards, the decree names the Ministry as issuer and CNGRA as coordinator; DAF's exact production role remains open.
review_notes: Do not assign final legal issuance authority to DAF where Decree No. 2025-1560 names the Ministry. The public hotline is not an API.

official_name: Direction générale de la Police nationale (DGPN)
mandate_summary: The Ministry describes the DGPN as responsible for control of the movement of persons at borders, management of foreigners' stay and establishment, and preparation and delivery of travel documents to nationals. It is the parent police directorate for the foreign-police and travel-document service branch.
api_or_digital_service_name: National Police administrative services
access_requirements: No public third-party API or external identity-verification interface is claimed.
case_route_or_procedure_summary: The DGPN carries out national police functions and provides the organizational framework for the Directorate of Foreigners Police and Travel Documents; application details are separately listed on the passport and foreigner identity service pages.
review_notes: Keep border-control, immigration and passport functions distinct from nationality adjudication.

official_name: Direction de la Police des Étrangers et des Titres de Voyage (DPETV)
english_name: Directorate of Foreigners Police and Travel Documents (DPETV)
mandate_summary: The Ministry's ordinary-passport service directs applicants to police stations and identifies the DPETV as the contact for further information. The foreigner identity-card service describes a DPETV intake route and DAF processing. The Directorate is listed as part of the DGPN structure; the Ministry remains the official source for the service procedure.
api_or_digital_service_name: Ordinary passport application; foreigner identity-card procedure
access_requirements: No API specification, external verification permission or sandbox is confirmed.
case_route_or_procedure_summary: Ordinary passport applicants apply through the police station assigned to their residence; Senegalese citizens abroad use the relevant embassy. Foreigner identity-card applications are submitted through DPETV and routed to DAF and DGPN for processing and approvals.
review_notes: Treat DPETV as an operational directorate under DGPN, not as a separately proven sovereign nationality authority. Passport issuance is for Senegalese citizens.
